P: Serve the snacks when Duckie dances on the record shop counter.
S: Iona's counter at the record store
Salted pretzels, red liquorice and pink sugared almonds tipped into mismatched bowls on the counter, next to the record player.
pink and sweet, like his big moment
Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate tinted pink with freeze-dried raspberry powder, spread to set.

edition.cue: Serve the snacks when Duckie dances on the record shop counter.

s.note: Salted pretzels, red liquorice and pink sugared almonds in mismatched bowls.
s.how: Tip 80g salted pretzels, 80g red liquorice and 80g pink sugared almonds into three mismatched bowls. Arrange beside the record player and share between four people.

s.note: Crisp popcorn in pink white chocolate with freeze dried raspberry.
s.how: Pop 50g popcorn kernels in 1 tbsp neutral oil in a covered pot over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, shaking regularly. Melt 80g white chocolate gently. Crush 10g freeze-dried raspberries to a powder and stir into the chocolate to tint it pink. Toss through the popcorn, spread on a lined tray and leave 20 minutes to set.

m.note: Slow braised beef with onion, carrot, garlic, potatoes and rich stock.
m.how: Season 900g beef chuck roast with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Brown all sides in 1 tbsp neutral oil in a heavy casserole for 8 minutes. Add 2 quartered brown onions, 3 chopped carrots, 4 garlic cloves and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160°C conventional for 3 hours. After 2 hours add 600g peeled potato chunks, cover and cook for the final hour until the beef and potatoes are tender. Rest the beef 15 minutes, slice or pull apart and serve with the vegetables and rich stock.

w.note: Vanilla and strawberry sponge joined with pink and white buttercream.
w.how: Heat the oven to 180°C conventional and line two 12cm round tins. Cook 100g chopped strawberries over low heat for 8 minutes until reduced to about 30g thick purée; cool. Beat 120g softened butter with 120g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 2 eggs, then fold in 140g self-raising flour. Divide the batter equally. Stir 1/2 tsp vanilla into one half and the strawberry purée into the other. Bake side by side for 20 to 25 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool, cut both cakes in half and join one vanilla and one strawberry semicircle using buttercream. Save the spare halves or use them for a second layer. Beat 80g softened butter with 160g icing sugar and 1 tsp milk. Tint half pink. Cover half the cake pink and half white, piping a seam along the join. Cut four portions.

d.note: Cranberry, pineapple and lemonade punch with frozen raspberries.
d.how: Mix 500ml cranberry juice, 500ml pineapple juice and 750ml lemonade in a big glass bowl. Add 2 sliced oranges and 150g frozen raspberries so they float on top. Ladle into 4 glasses over ice.
